sections.heading: Introducing Yourself
paragraphs: Use 'A nevem…' (My name is…) or 'Én … vagyok' (I am …) to introduce yourself.
list: A nevem Anna. – My name is Anna.
Én Péter vagyok. – I am Péter.

sections.heading: Greetings
paragraphs: Greetings change by time of day. Common polite forms are short and direct.
